Bought this tie down kit primarily for my sxs. My sxs is only 1800lbs so its overkill but I wanted some redundancy. The different sizes of axle straps allow me to tie down my sxs in several different ways. I also like how the ratchet strap has a wear sleeve. This kit is also future proof if I tow anything heavier. These are very heavy duty and well made.

Haven't tried the straps yet but from all indications they look very good, and of good quality. Heavy duty handles and hooks. In my opinion on par with other manufacturers, but at much more reasonable price. Just an FYI, dont believe the shipping arrival date put in the description, I waited almost 14 days to receive and in the description it stated delivery within 3 days.
